notes: INTENT: a table with RLS off is a total data exposure (anyone with the anon key reads/writes it), and a service-role key behind a NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix is compiled into the browser bundle verbatim. Both are provable from source, so both must grade as confirmed P0s. The fixed variant enables RLS with an owner-scoped auth.uid() policy and moves the key server-side (no public prefix), so it must be completely silent. This pair guards the two flagship static detectors (CG-DB-001, CG-ENV-001).
